note: Valid but unusual (format 3.11): a state whose own exits are all instant, the last with an if, is valid when a shared exit lists it; a cycle through a state whose steps hold an until waits there, so it is valid. The until's region holds 0.05 s (stay_s): with stay_s 0 it is met at its arm while the pad stays out, and the cycle is refused (F26, decided 2026-11-12).
